headline: YOUTUBE CARRIES 44.4 PERCENT OF EVERY ADVERTISING MINUTE AMERICANS SIT THROUGH ON STREAMING, AND ALL OF STREAMING IS STILL ONLY 22.3 PERCENT OF TELEVISION ADVERTISING MINUTES.  THE NEW NUMBER GOES UP WHEN A PLATFORM SIMPLY RUNS MORE ADS
deck: Comscore launched a monthly television report this morning built on a metric nobody was quoting last week, and by this time next month somebody will be quoting it at you in a planning meeting.  It is not watch time and it is not reach.  It is the number of advertising minutes a person actually sat through, which means it rises when a platform shows more adverts, and that makes the league table it produces a different thing from the one everybody will read it as.
tldr: Comscore's new metric says YouTube carries 44.4 percent of the advertising minutes Americans sit through on streaming, while all of streaming is 22.3 percent of television's advertising minutes.  Say advertising minutes sat through, never share of streaming advertising, and take the gap between half the watching and a fifth of the adverts into your next owned-video conversation.

Meta's block on ByteDance also catches third-party creative that links out to TikTok or TikTok Shop.  Audit every Meta advert you are running for a client this quarter for TikTok end cards, captions and link destinations, and rebuild the ones that point there before the Black Friday flight locks.

Anthropologie used a July creator campaign to decide what to stock for autumn and grew its customer base more than 4 percent, with full-price sales turning positive.  Tag every asset in your next creator campaign to a product rather than to the campaign, and get the read-out to whoever decides what gets made within two weeks of the flight.

A study of twenty adverts found human-made work 14 percent stronger short-term and 17 percent long-term, except on the one brand with the clearest brief, where the machine won.  Split your rate card into formulaic versioning and original work this quarter and price them separately.

Netflix cut its advertising expectation to about 2.7 billion dollars for product delays, and in the same week shipped a tracking tag covering more than 20 lower-funnel conversion events.  Add six and fifteen second performance cuts with a product beat to any Netflix brief in your pipeline, and get written delivery dates before you commit to next year.

Twitch now puts a stream's highlight reel at the top of followers' feeds, includes your editors by default, and feeds its engagement back into clip recommendations.  Get your editors added as channel editors on client streams and brief the talent to say Twitch Clip That on the brand beat.

31 percent of baby boomers trust creator recommendations against 62 percent of Gen Z, while boomers hold 42 percent of the spending in well-off American households and the older creators who convert better keep getting rejected by clients.  Put an interest-match option in your next casting deck and agree a longer measurement window before the campaign runs.
